objects.description: Opaque-by-convention value type representing a UTF-8 byte sequence with explicit length. Buf may be NULL when Length is 0. Some constructors copy input, while Wrap variants reference external memory managed by the caller.
Generic byte buffer view with length; may either own an internal copy (Create) or reference external memory (Wrap). Buf may be NULL when Length is 0.
Compact result/status code container for C API calls. Code encodes category and 24-bit code; special success-like constants exist (WasmEdge_Result_Success, _Terminate, _Fail).
Enumeration selecting the global logging verbosity and used in log messages.
Structured log record delivered to user callbacks, containing message text, logger name, severity level, timestamp, and thread id.
Function pointer type for receiving log messages emitted by the runtime.
WASM limits descriptor used by table and memory types. Contains optional maximum, a shared flag, and min/max page counts. Used throughout the AST type APIs to constrain sizes.
Opaque compiler context used by the WasmEdge AOT compiler APIs. Only referenced in this header; its structure is not defined here and is managed via the create/compile/delete functions.
Result handle/struct returned by WasmEdge APIs to convey success or error and an optional message. It is only referenced here; the concrete definition is not present in this header.
Opaque configuration context used to parameterize creation of other contexts (e.g., Compiler). Only referenced here; the structure is not defined in this header.
Byte-sequence wrapper used by WasmEdge to pass WASM binaries. Referenced here as an input to compilation; the actual definition is not in this header.
Opaque loader context for parsing/loading WASM modules. Only referenced here; structure is not defined in this header.
Opaque AST module context representing a parsed WASM module. Constructed by loader parse APIs; the concrete definition is not present here.
Unsigned 8-bit integer type from <stdint.h>, used here as a pointer to a buffer of WASM bytes.
Unsigned 32-bit integer type from <stdint.h>, used here to pass buffer length by value; included for completeness though it’s a builtin typedef, not defined in this header.

Opaque configuration context for WasmEdge. This header only references the type; its full definition is not present here. It is created with WasmEdge_ConfigureCreate and destroyed with WasmEdge_ConfigureDelete. It is passed to various Configure* APIs to set proposals, standards, host registrations, limits, and compiler/statistics options. Thread-safe for the documented operations.

Opaque statistics context for gathering execution statistics in WasmEdge. This header only references the type; its full definition is not present here. Create with WasmEdge_StatisticsCreate and destroy with WasmEdge_StatisticsDelete. Provides counters such as instruction count, instructions per second, total cost, and supports cost table/limit configuration and clearing.
Opaque context type representing WasmEdge configuration settings. Details are hidden; used to create and hold engine configuration options.
Opaque context that holds execution statistics (e.g., instruction counts, costs). Exact fields are private.
Opaque context for a parsed WebAssembly AST module before instantiation.
Opaque context describing a function type (parameter and result types).
Opaque context describing a memory type (min/max pages, memory64, etc.).
Opaque context describing a table type (element type and limits).
Opaque context describing a WebAssembly exception tag type.
Opaque context describing a global variable type (value type and mutability).
Opaque context describing an import entry (module/name and type).
Opaque context describing an export entry (name and external type).
Opaque context for the WasmEdge AOT compiler component.
Opaque context for loading/parsing WASM or AOT binaries into AST modules.
Opaque context for validating modules against the WebAssembly rules and configured features.
Opaque context for executing functions, instantiating modules, and interacting with the runtime.
Opaque context representing the store of instantiated modules and instances.
Opaque context for a live instantiated module (exports, memories, tables, globals, functions).
Opaque context for a function instance ready for invocation within a store/module.
Opaque context for a table instance within an instantiated module.
Opaque context for a memory instance within an instantiated module.
Opaque context for an exception tag instance within an instantiated module.
Opaque context for a global variable instance within an instantiated module.
Opaque context representing a calling frame passed to host functions (access to store, module, etc.).
Opaque context representing an asynchronous result/handle for async execution.
Opaque context for the WasmEdge virtual machine that integrates loader, validator, executor, and store.
Opaque context for a WasmEdge plugin (extension module providing additional host functions or features).

Function pointer type for host functions implemented by the embedder and exposed to Wasm. Called with opaque user Data, a calling frame context, input parameter array, and output results array, returning a WasmEdge_Result status.

Function pointer type for wrapper host functions used by languages that cannot pass direct function pointers. Receives a This binding, opaque Data, the calling frame, and explicit lengths for Params/Returns, returning a WasmEdge_Result.

Enumeration of option value types that a plugin program option may accept, including numeric, boolean, floating point, and string types. Used within WasmEdge_ProgramOption to declare the storage/value interpretation.

Descriptor of a single plugin program option. Holds the option name, description, type, a storage pointer where the parsed value will be written, and an optional default value. Storage and DefaultValue lifetimes are managed by the plugin; callers should not free them.

Descriptor for a plugin-provided module. Contains the module name, description, and a Create function pointer that constructs a WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceContext for this module when invoked. The Create callback is implemented by the plugin.
Semantic-like version information for a plugin: major, minor, patch, and build numbers. Embedded in WasmEdge_PluginDescriptor.

Top-level descriptor that a plugin exports via WasmEdge_Plugin_GetDescriptor. Describes plugin metadata (name, description), API compatibility version, the plugin's own version, and arrays of module descriptors and program options with their counts. Memory for arrays and strings is owned by the plugin.

No custom types are defined in this header. It only declares C API functions for WasmEdge driver/tools. All referenced types are built-in C types (int, const char **, const wchar_t **) and macros for export/guards.

Opaque-by-convention value type descriptor for WASM values in the WasmEdge C API. It stores raw bytes encoding a value type (e.g., i32, i64, f32, f64, v128, funcref, externref, nullable/non-nullable refs). Users should construct and compare via the provided WasmEdge_ValTypeGen* and WasmEdge_ValTypeIs* APIs; internal layout is not public.

Opaque-by-convention WASM runtime value carrier for the WasmEdge C API, holding the raw 128-bit payload and its WasmEdge_ValType. Construct using WasmEdge_ValueGen* helpers and extract using WasmEdge_ValueGet* or reference query functions. Supports numeric types (i32, i64, f32, f64, v128) and reference types (funcref, externref, nullable).

Opaque VM context type for the WasmEdge C API. This header only declares functions operating on WasmEdge_VMContext; its actual struct definition is not present here and is expected to be provided elsewhere as an opaque type. Ownership is typically with the caller when created via WasmEdge_VMCreate and must be released with WasmEdge_VMDelete. Many APIs return internal sub-context pointers that are owned by the VM and must not be deleted by the caller.
Opaque compiler context type referenced by deprecated APIs for compiling WASM. Not defined in this header; definition is elsewhere.
Result structure or typedef used to report success or error codes from WasmEdge C API functions. Only referenced here; the definition is not present in this header.
Opaque VM context type used by VM-related deprecated APIs. Not defined in this header; definition is elsewhere.
String handle/type used by the WasmEdge C API. Only referenced here; no definition in this header.
Value container type for passing parameters and receiving results to/from WASM functions. Only referenced here; not defined in this header.
Handle for asynchronous VM invocations returned by async APIs. Only referenced here; definition not present in this header.

128-bit unsigned integer type for the WasmEdge C API. On 64-bit targets that support the GNU extension type, it aliases the built-in unsigned __int128; otherwise it is a struct with Low/High 64-bit limbs (little-endian layout implied by naming). Behavior for arithmetic is not defined here; users must implement operations or rely on API functions elsewhere.

128-bit signed integer type for the WasmEdge C API. On supported 64-bit targets it aliases the built-in __int128; otherwise it is a struct with a 64-bit unsigned Low part and a 64-bit signed High part holding the sign-extended upper limb. Arithmetic semantics are not provided here; users must implement as needed or use higher-level APIs.

functions.name: WasmEdge_VersionGet
functions.description: Returns a NULL-terminated C string with the WasmEdge C API version. The returned string is owned by the library and must not be destroyed by the caller.
requirements: Caller must not attempt to free or modify the returned string.
Returned pointer is valid for read-only use; lifetime is managed by the library.

functions.name: WasmEdge_LogSetErrorLevel
functions.description: Sets the logging system to filter at error level.

functions.name: WasmEdge_LogSetDebugLevel
functions.description: Sets the logging system to filter at debug level.

functions.name: WasmEdge_LogOff
functions.description: Disables the logging system.

functions.name: WasmEdge_LogSetLevel
functions.description: Sets the logging system to the specified level.
requirements: Level must be a valid WasmEdge_LogLevel enum value.

functions.name: WasmEdge_LogSetCallback
functions.description: Registers a callback to receive log messages emitted by the logging system. The callback receives a pointer to a WasmEdge_LogMessage describing each event.
requirements: Callback must be a valid function pointer of type WasmEdge_LogCallback_t.
Threading and reentrancy behavior are not specified in this header; callers should ensure the callback is thread-safe if logs may be emitted from multiple threads.
It is unknown whether NULL is accepted to clear the callback; this behavior is not documented here.

functions.name: WasmEdge_StringCreateByCString
functions.description: Creates a WasmEdge_String by copying from a NULL-terminated C string. The caller owns the returned object and must delete it with WasmEdge_StringDelete. If Str is NULL or creation fails, returns an object with Length=0 and Buf=NULL.
requirements: Str must be a NULL-terminated C string when non-NULL.
Caller must later call WasmEdge_StringDelete on the returned object to release resources unless Length==0 and Buf==NULL (safe to pass to delete regardless).

functions.name: WasmEdge_StringCreateByBuffer
functions.signature: WASMEDGE_CAPI_EXPORT extern WasmEdge_String WasmEdge_StringCreateByBuffer(const char *Buf, const uint32_t Len);
functions.description: Creates a WasmEdge_String by copying Len bytes from Buf. The caller owns the returned object and must delete it with WasmEdge_StringDelete. If Buf is NULL or creation fails, returns an object with Length=0 and Buf=NULL.
requirements: Buf must point to at least Len bytes when non-NULL.
Caller must call WasmEdge_StringDelete on the returned object to release resources unless Length==0 and Buf==NULL (safe to pass to delete regardless).

functions.name: WasmEdge_StringWrap
functions.signature: WASMEDGE_CAPI_EXPORT extern WasmEdge_String WasmEdge_StringWrap(const char *Buf, const uint32_t Len);
functions.description: Creates a WasmEdge_String that wraps (references) the provided buffer without copying. The caller must guarantee the lifetime of Buf for as long as the wrapped string is used and must not call WasmEdge_StringDelete on the wrapped string.
requirements: Buf must point to at least Len bytes valid for the duration of all uses of the returned WasmEdge_String.
Caller must not call WasmEdge_StringDelete on the wrapped string.
Do not modify or free Buf while the wrapped string may still be accessed.

functions.name: WasmEdge_StringIsEqual
functions.signature: WASMEDGE_CAPI_EXPORT extern bool WasmEdge_StringIsEqual(const WasmEdge_String Str1, const WasmEdge_String Str2);
functions.description: Compares two WasmEdge_String objects for content equality.
requirements: Str1 and Str2 must be valid, initialized WasmEdge_String values.

functions.name: WasmEdge_StringCopy
functions.signature: WASMEDGE_CAPI_EXPORT extern uint32_t WasmEdge_StringCopy(const WasmEdge_String Str, char *Buf, const uint32_t Len);
functions.description: Copies at most Len characters from Str into Buf. If Str is shorter than Len, the remainder of Buf is filled with '\0'. Otherwise, the destination is not null-terminated. Returns the number of characters copied.
requirements: Buf must point to a writable buffer of at least Len bytes.
Str must be a valid, initialized WasmEdge_String.
Caller must handle that Buf may not be null-terminated when Str.Length >= Len.

functions.name: WasmEdge_StringDelete
functions.description: Releases resources held by a WasmEdge_String created by copying (e.g., via WasmEdge_StringCreateByCString or WasmEdge_StringCreateByBuffer). After deletion, Str must not be used.
requirements: Str must refer to a deletable WasmEdge_String (not one created with WasmEdge_StringWrap).
Do not use Str after calling this function.

functions.name: WasmEdge_BytesCreate
functions.signature: WASMEDGE_CAPI_EXPORT extern WasmEdge_Bytes WasmEdge_BytesCreate(const uint8_t *Buf, const uint32_t Len);
functions.description: Creates a WasmEdge_Bytes by copying Len bytes from Buf. The caller owns the returned object and must delete it with WasmEdge_BytesDelete. If Buf is NULL or creation fails, returns an object with Length=0 and Buf=NULL.
requirements: Buf must point to at least Len bytes when non-NULL.
Caller must call WasmEdge_BytesDelete on the returned object to release resources unless Length==0 and Buf==NULL (safe to pass to delete regardless).

functions.name: WasmEdge_BytesWrap
functions.signature: WASMEDGE_CAPI_EXPORT extern WasmEdge_Bytes WasmEdge_BytesWrap(const uint8_t *Buf, const uint32_t Len);
functions.description: Creates a WasmEdge_Bytes that wraps (references) the provided buffer without copying. The caller must guarantee the lifetime of Buf for as long as the wrapped bytes are used and must not call WasmEdge_BytesDelete on the wrapped object.
requirements: Buf must point to at least Len bytes valid for the duration of all uses of the returned WasmEdge_Bytes.
Caller must not call WasmEdge_BytesDelete on the wrapped object.
Do not modify or free Buf while the wrapped object may still be accessed.

functions.name: WasmEdge_BytesDelete
functions.description: Releases resources held by a WasmEdge_Bytes created by copying (e.g., via WasmEdge_BytesCreate). After deletion, Bytes must not be used.
requirements: Bytes must refer to a deletable WasmEdge_Bytes (not one created with WasmEdge_BytesWrap).
Do not use Bytes after calling this function.

functions.name: WasmEdge_ResultOK
functions.signature: WASMEDGE_CAPI_EXPORT extern bool WasmEdge_ResultOK(const WasmEdge_Result Res);
functions.description: Reports whether a result indicates success. Returns true if Res is either WasmEdge_Result_Success or WasmEdge_Result_Terminate; false otherwise.
requirements: Res must be an initialized WasmEdge_Result value.

functions.name: WasmEdge_ResultGen
functions.signature: WASMEDGE_CAPI_EXPORT extern WasmEdge_Result WasmEdge_ResultGen(const enum WasmEdge_ErrCategory Category, const uint32_t Code);
functions.description: Constructs a WasmEdge_Result from an error category and a 24-bit error code. Any bits above 24 in Code are stripped.
requirements: Category must be a valid WasmEdge_ErrCategory enum value.
Code is treated as a 24-bit value; higher bits will be discarded.

functions.name: WasmEdge_ResultGetCode
functions.signature: WASMEDGE_CAPI_EXPORT extern uint32_t WasmEdge_ResultGetCode(const WasmEdge_Result Res);
functions.description: Returns the 24-bit result code stored in Res.
requirements: Res must be an initialized WasmEdge_Result value.

functions.name: WasmEdge_ResultGetCategory
functions.signature: WASMEDGE_CAPI_EXPORT extern enum WasmEdge_ErrCategory WasmEdge_ResultGetCategory(const WasmEdge_Result Res);
functions.description: Returns the error category stored in Res.
requirements: Res must be an initialized WasmEdge_Result value.

functions.name: WasmEdge_ResultGetMessage
functions.signature: WASMEDGE_CAPI_EXPORT extern const char *WasmEdge_ResultGetMessage(const WasmEdge_Result Res);
functions.description: Returns a NULL-terminated C string representing the error message for Res. Do not free the returned string. If the category is not WasmEdge_ErrCategory_WASM, the message is always "user defined error code".
requirements: Caller must not attempt to free or modify the returned string.
Res must be an initialized WasmEdge_Result value.

functions.name: WasmEdge_LimitIsEqual
functions.signature: extern bool WasmEdge_LimitIsEqual(const WasmEdge_Limit Lim1, const WasmEdge_Limit Lim2);
functions.description: Compares two WasmEdge_Limit structs for equality. Intended to check whether Min/Max/HasMax/Shared match exactly between two limits.
requirements: Lim1 and Lim2 must be valid WasmEdge_Limit values.
Returns true only if all fields (HasMax, Shared, Min, Max) are identical; otherwise false.

functions.name: WasmEdge_ASTModuleListImportsLength
functions.description: Returns the number of import entries in the given AST module. Use to size a buffer before calling WasmEdge_ASTModuleListImports.
requirements: Cxt must point to a valid WasmEdge_ASTModuleContext.
If Cxt is invalid, behavior is unspecified in this header.

functions.name: WasmEdge_ASTModuleListImports
functions.signature: extern uint32_t WasmEdge_ASTModuleListImports(const WasmEdge_ASTModuleContext *Cxt, const WasmEdge_ImportTypeContext **Imports, const uint32_t Len);
functions.description: Retrieves up to Len import type handles from an AST module into the provided buffer. Overflowed results are discarded. Returns the actual number of import entries in the module (not just the number written).
requirements: Cxt must be a valid WasmEdge_ASTModuleContext.
Imports may be NULL if the caller only wants the count (entries are not written).
Len specifies the capacity of the Imports buffer in number of elements; entries beyond Len are discarded.
Call WasmEdge_ASTModuleListImportsLength first to size the buffer if you want all entries.

functions.name: WasmEdge_ASTModuleListExportsLength
functions.description: Returns the number of export entries in the given AST module. Use to size a buffer before calling WasmEdge_ASTModuleListExports.
requirements: Cxt must point to a valid WasmEdge_ASTModuleContext.

functions.name: WasmEdge_ASTModuleListExports
functions.signature: extern uint32_t WasmEdge_ASTModuleListExports(const WasmEdge_ASTModuleContext *Cxt, const WasmEdge_ExportTypeContext **Exports, const uint32_t Len);
functions.description: Retrieves up to Len export type handles from an AST module into the provided buffer. Overflowed results are discarded. Returns the actual number of export entries in the module (not just the number written).
requirements: Cxt must be a valid WasmEdge_ASTModuleContext.
Exports may be NULL if the caller only wants the count (entries are not written).
Len specifies the capacity of the Exports buffer in number of elements; entries beyond Len are discarded.
Use WasmEdge_ASTModuleListExportsLength to size the buffer when needed.

functions.name: WasmEdge_ASTModuleDelete
functions.description: Destroys an AST module context. After deletion, the context must not be used.
requirements: Cxt must be a context previously obtained from WasmEdge APIs that create an AST module.
After calling this function, the Cxt is invalid and must not be used again.

functions.name: WasmEdge_FunctionTypeCreate
functions.signature: extern WasmEdge_FunctionTypeContext *WasmEdge_FunctionTypeCreate(const WasmEdge_ValType *ParamList, const uint32_t ParamLen, const WasmEdge_ValType *ReturnList, const uint32_t ReturnLen);
functions.description: Creates a function type context with specified parameter and return value types. Caller owns the returned object and must delete it with WasmEdge_FunctionTypeDelete.
requirements: ParamList may be NULL if ParamLen is 0; otherwise ParamList must point to an array of ParamLen WasmEdge_ValType entries.
ReturnList may be NULL if ReturnLen is 0; otherwise ReturnList must point to an array of ReturnLen WasmEdge_ValType entries.
Returns NULL on failure; caller must check for NULL before use.
Caller must eventually call WasmEdge_FunctionTypeDelete on the returned context.

functions.name: WasmEdge_FunctionTypeGetParametersLength
functions.description: Returns the number of parameter value types in the function type context.
requirements: Cxt must be a valid WasmEdge_FunctionTypeContext.

functions.name: WasmEdge_FunctionTypeGetParameters
functions.signature: extern uint32_t WasmEdge_FunctionTypeGetParameters(const WasmEdge_FunctionTypeContext *Cxt, WasmEdge_ValType *List, const uint32_t Len);
functions.description: Copies up to Len parameter value types into List. Overflowed values are discarded. Returns the total number of parameter types in the function type (not just those written).
requirements: Cxt must be a valid WasmEdge_FunctionTypeContext.
List must point to a writable buffer of at least Len elements of WasmEdge_ValType.
If Len is smaller than the number of parameters, extra entries are discarded.
Use WasmEdge_FunctionTypeGetParametersLength to size List when needed.

functions.name: WasmEdge_FunctionTypeGetReturnsLength
functions.description: Returns the number of return value types in the function type context.
requirements: Cxt must be a valid WasmEdge_FunctionTypeContext.

functions.name: WasmEdge_FunctionTypeGetReturns
functions.signature: extern uint32_t WasmEdge_FunctionTypeGetReturns(const WasmEdge_FunctionTypeContext *Cxt, WasmEdge_ValType *List, const uint32_t Len);
functions.description: Copies up to Len return value types into List. Overflowed values are discarded. Returns the total number of return types in the function type (not just those written).
requirements: Cxt must be a valid WasmEdge_FunctionTypeContext.
List must point to a writable buffer of at least Len elements of WasmEdge_ValType.
If Len is smaller than the number of returns, extra entries are discarded.
Use WasmEdge_FunctionTypeGetReturnsLength to size List when needed.

functions.name: WasmEdge_FunctionTypeDelete
functions.description: Destroys a function type context. After deletion, the context must not be used.
requirements: Cxt must be a context previously created by WasmEdge_FunctionTypeCreate or obtained from APIs that transfer ownership (none indicated here).
After calling, Cxt is invalid and must not be used again.

functions.name: WasmEdge_TableTypeCreate
functions.signature: extern WasmEdge_TableTypeContext *WasmEdge_TableTypeCreate(const WasmEdge_ValType RefType, const WasmEdge_Limit Limit);
functions.description: Creates a table type context with the given reference type and limit. Caller owns the object and must delete it with WasmEdge_TableTypeDelete.
requirements: RefType must be a reference type; otherwise creation fails (function returns NULL).
Limit must be a valid WasmEdge_Limit; if HasMax is false, Max is ignored.
Returns NULL on failure; caller must check for NULL.
Caller must eventually call WasmEdge_TableTypeDelete on the returned context.

functions.name: WasmEdge_TableTypeGetRefType
functions.description: Returns the element/reference value type of the table type. This value type is a reference type.
requirements: Cxt must be a valid WasmEdge_TableTypeContext.

functions.name: WasmEdge_TableTypeGetLimit
functions.description: Returns the limit (min/max and flags) of the table type.
requirements: Cxt must be a valid WasmEdge_TableTypeContext.

functions.name: WasmEdge_TableTypeDelete
functions.description: Destroys a table type context. After deletion, the context must not be used.
requirements: Cxt must be a context previously created by WasmEdge_TableTypeCreate.
After calling, Cxt is invalid and must not be used again.

functions.name: WasmEdge_MemoryTypeCreate
functions.description: Creates a memory type context with the given limit. Caller owns the returned object and must delete it with WasmEdge_MemoryTypeDelete.
requirements: Limit must be a valid WasmEdge_Limit; if HasMax is false, Max is ignored.
Returns NULL on failure; caller must check for NULL.
Caller must eventually call WasmEdge_MemoryTypeDelete on the returned context.

functions.name: WasmEdge_MemoryTypeGetLimit
functions.description: Returns the limit of the memory type.
requirements: Cxt must be a valid WasmEdge_MemoryTypeContext.

functions.name: WasmEdge_MemoryTypeDelete
functions.description: Destroys a memory type context. After deletion, the context must not be used.
requirements: Cxt must be a context previously created by WasmEdge_MemoryTypeCreate.
After calling, Cxt is invalid and must not be used again.

functions.name: WasmEdge_TagTypeGetFunctionType
functions.description: Returns the function type associated with a tag type. Useful for exception/tag constructs that carry function-type signatures.
requirements: Cxt must be a valid WasmEdge_TagTypeContext.
Returns NULL on failure.

functions.name: WasmEdge_GlobalTypeCreate
functions.signature: extern WasmEdge_GlobalTypeContext *WasmEdge_GlobalTypeCreate(const WasmEdge_ValType ValType, const enum WasmEdge_Mutability Mut);
functions.description: Creates a global type context with the specified value type and mutability. Caller owns the object and must delete it with WasmEdge_GlobalTypeDelete.
requirements: ValType must be a valid WasmEdge_ValType.
Mut must be a valid WasmEdge_Mutability enumerator.
Returns NULL on failure; caller must check for NULL.
Caller must eventually call WasmEdge_GlobalTypeDelete on the returned context.

functions.name: WasmEdge_GlobalTypeGetValType
functions.description: Returns the value type of the global type.
requirements: Cxt must be a valid WasmEdge_GlobalTypeContext.

functions.name: WasmEdge_GlobalTypeGetMutability
functions.description: Returns the mutability (const or var) of the global type.
requirements: Cxt must be a valid WasmEdge_GlobalTypeContext.

functions.name: WasmEdge_GlobalTypeDelete
functions.description: Destroys a global type context. After deletion, the context must not be used.
requirements: Cxt must be a context previously created by WasmEdge_GlobalTypeCreate.
After calling, Cxt is invalid and must not be used again.

functions.name: WasmEdge_ImportTypeGetExternalType
functions.description: Returns the external kind (function, table, memory, tag, or global) of the import type.
requirements: Cxt must be a valid WasmEdge_ImportTypeContext.

functions.name: WasmEdge_ImportTypeGetModuleName
functions.description: Returns the module name string of the import. The returned string is linked to internal storage; do not free it.
requirements: Cxt must be a valid WasmEdge_ImportTypeContext.
The returned WasmEdge_String must not be deleted via WasmEdge_StringDelete.
On failure, the returned string has Length 0 and Buf == NULL.

functions.name: WasmEdge_ImportTypeGetExternalName
functions.description: Returns the external name string of the import. The returned string is linked to internal storage; do not free it.
requirements: Cxt must be a valid WasmEdge_ImportTypeContext.
The returned WasmEdge_String must not be deleted via WasmEdge_StringDelete.
On failure, the returned string has Length 0 and Buf == NULL.

functions.name: WasmEdge_ImportTypeGetFunctionType
functions.signature: extern const WasmEdge_FunctionTypeContext *WasmEdge_ImportTypeGetFunctionType(const WasmEdge_ASTModuleContext *ASTCxt, const WasmEdge_ImportTypeContext *Cxt);
functions.description: Returns the function type associated with an import entry of kind Function. The returned context is linked to the AST module/import; do not delete it.
requirements: ASTCxt must be the WasmEdge_ASTModuleContext from which Cxt was queried.
Cxt must be an import type handle obtained from ASTCxt via WasmEdge_ASTModuleListImports.
The import’s external type must be WasmEdge_ExternalType_Function; otherwise NULL is returned.
Caller must not delete the returned function type context (ownership not transferred).
Using a Cxt not originating from ASTCxt may cause unexpected errors.

functions.name: WasmEdge_ImportTypeGetTableType
functions.signature: extern const WasmEdge_TableTypeContext *WasmEdge_ImportTypeGetTableType(const WasmEdge_ASTModuleContext *ASTCxt, const WasmEdge_ImportTypeContext *Cxt);
functions.description: Returns the table type associated with an import entry of kind Table. The returned context is linked to the AST module/import; do not delete it.
requirements: ASTCxt must be the WasmEdge_ASTModuleContext from which Cxt was queried.
Cxt must be an import type handle obtained from ASTCxt via WasmEdge_ASTModuleListImports.
The import’s external type must be WasmEdge_ExternalType_Table; otherwise NULL is returned.
Caller must not delete the returned table type context.
Using a Cxt not originating from ASTCxt may cause unexpected errors.

functions.name: WasmEdge_ImportTypeGetMemoryType
functions.signature: extern const WasmEdge_MemoryTypeContext *WasmEdge_ImportTypeGetMemoryType(const WasmEdge_ASTModuleContext *ASTCxt, const WasmEdge_ImportTypeContext *Cxt);
functions.description: Returns the memory type associated with an import entry of kind Memory. The returned context is linked to the AST module/import; do not delete it.
requirements: ASTCxt must be the WasmEdge_ASTModuleContext from which Cxt was queried.
Cxt must be an import type handle obtained from ASTCxt via WasmEdge_ASTModuleListImports.
The import’s external type must be WasmEdge_ExternalType_Memory; otherwise NULL is returned.
Caller must not delete the returned memory type context.
Using a Cxt not originating from ASTCxt may cause unexpected errors.

functions.name: WasmEdge_ImportTypeGetTagType
functions.signature: extern const WasmEdge_TagTypeContext *WasmEdge_ImportTypeGetTagType(const WasmEdge_ASTModuleContext *ASTCxt, const WasmEdge_ImportTypeContext *Cxt);
functions.description: Returns the tag type associated with an import entry of kind Tag. The returned context is linked to the AST module/import.
requirements: ASTCxt must be the WasmEdge_ASTModuleContext from which Cxt was queried.
Cxt must be an import type handle obtained from ASTCxt via WasmEdge_ASTModuleListImports.
The import’s external type must be WasmEdge_ExternalType_TagType (per comment) to succeed; otherwise NULL is returned.
Using a Cxt not originating from ASTCxt may cause unexpected errors.

functions.name: WasmEdge_ImportTypeGetGlobalType

functions.signature: WASMEDGE_CAPI_EXPORT extern WasmEdge_Result WasmEdge_ExecutorRegisterImport(WasmEdge_ExecutorContext *Cxt, WasmEdge_StoreContext *StoreCxt, const WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceContext *ImportCxt);
functions.description: Registers an existing module instance into the store under its module name so other modules can import from it. The store does not take ownership; the module instance will be unregistered automatically when deleted.
requirements: Cxt must be a valid WasmEdge_ExecutorContext
StoreCxt must be a valid WasmEdge_StoreContext
ImportCxt must be a valid WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceContext to register
Caller must guarantee the lifetime of ImportCxt while other modules may import from it; deleting it prematurely can cause execution errors
Always check the returned WasmEdge_Result (use WasmEdge_ResultGetMessage for error details)

functions.name: WasmEdge_ExecutorInvoke
functions.signature: WASMEDGE_CAPI_EXPORT extern WasmEdge_Result WasmEdge_ExecutorInvoke(WasmEdge_ExecutorContext *Cxt, const WasmEdge_FunctionInstanceContext *FuncCxt, const WasmEdge_Value *Params, const uint32_t ParamLen, WasmEdge_Value *Returns, const uint32_t ReturnLen);
functions.description: Synchronously invokes a function instance with the provided parameters and writes return values into the Returns buffer. Returns a WasmEdge_Result indicating success or failure.
requirements: Cxt must be a valid WasmEdge_ExecutorContext
FuncCxt must be a valid WasmEdge_FunctionInstanceContext obtained from a module instance
Params must point to a buffer containing ParamLen WasmEdge_Value entries that match the function’s parameter types
Returns must point to a buffer capable of holding ReturnLen WasmEdge_Value entries matching the function’s return arity and types
ParamLen and ReturnLen must match the function instance’s expected arity
Always check the returned WasmEdge_Result (use WasmEdge_ResultGetMessage for error details)

functions.name: WasmEdge_ExecutorAsyncInvoke
functions.signature: WASMEDGE_CAPI_EXPORT extern WasmEdge_Async *WasmEdge_ExecutorAsyncInvoke(WasmEdge_ExecutorContext *Cxt, const WasmEdge_FunctionInstanceContext *FuncCxt, const WasmEdge_Value *Params, const uint32_t ParamLen);
functions.description: Asynchronously invokes a function instance with the provided parameters and returns a WasmEdge_Async handle. Use WasmEdge_AsyncGet (and related APIs) to obtain results, and delete the handle with WasmEdge_AsyncDelete.
requirements: Cxt must be a valid WasmEdge_ExecutorContext
FuncCxt must be a valid WasmEdge_FunctionInstanceContext obtained from a module instance
Params must point to a buffer containing ParamLen WasmEdge_Value entries that match the function’s parameter types
ParamLen must match the function instance’s expected parameter arity
On success, the returned WasmEdge_Async must eventually be deleted with WasmEdge_AsyncDelete

functions.name: WasmEdge_ExecutorDelete
functions.description: Destroys a WasmEdge_ExecutorContext. The context must not be used after this call.
requirements: Cxt must be a WasmEdge_ExecutorContext returned by WasmEdge_ExecutorCreate (or NULL)
Do not use Cxt after deletion
Avoid double-deletion
If a statistics context was provided at creation, ensure it outlives the executor until this call (per creation contract)

functions.name: WasmEdge_StoreCreate
functions.description: Creates a WasmEdge_StoreContext to act as a linker for multiple module instances. The store does not take ownership of registered modules; they auto-unregister when destroyed. Caller must delete the store with WasmEdge_StoreDelete.
requirements: On success, the returned context must be deleted with WasmEdge_StoreDelete
Modules registered into the store are not owned by the store; ensure their lifetimes are managed by the caller

functions.name: WasmEdge_StoreFindModule
functions.signature: WASMEDGE_CAPI_EXPORT extern const WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceContext *WasmEdge_StoreFindModule(const WasmEdge_StoreContext *Cxt, const WasmEdge_String Name);
functions.description: Finds a registered module instance in the store by module name. Thread-safe. Returns NULL if not found.
requirements: Cxt must be a valid WasmEdge_StoreContext
Name must be a valid WasmEdge_String representing the module name to search

functions.name: WasmEdge_StoreListModuleLength
functions.description: Returns the number of registered named modules in the store. Thread-safe.
requirements: Cxt must be a valid WasmEdge_StoreContext

functions.name: WasmEdge_StoreListModule
functions.signature: WASMEDGE_CAPI_EXPORT extern uint32_t WasmEdge_StoreListModule(const WasmEdge_StoreContext *Cxt, WasmEdge_String *Names, const uint32_t Len);
functions.description: Lists the registered module names into the provided array and returns the total number of registered modules. The names written into Names are linked to the store’s internal names; the caller must not delete them. If Len is smaller than the number of modules, overflowed names are discarded. Thread-safe.
requirements: Cxt must be a valid WasmEdge_StoreContext
Names must point to a buffer capable of holding Len WasmEdge_String entries
Do not call WasmEdge_StringDelete on the names written into Names; they are linked to the store
If Len is smaller than the total number of modules, excess names are discarded; the function still returns the actual total size

functions.name: WasmEdge_StoreDelete
functions.description: Destroys a WasmEdge_StoreContext. Registered module instances will be automatically unlinked from this store. The context must not be used after deletion.
requirements: Cxt must be a WasmEdge_StoreContext returned by WasmEdge_StoreCreate (or NULL)
Do not use Cxt after deletion
Avoid double-deletion

functions.name: WasmEdge_CallingFrameGetExecutor
functions.description: Returns the executor context associated with the current calling frame. Returns NULL if Cxt is NULL.
requirements: Cxt should be a valid WasmEdge_CallingFrameContext from a host function invocation frame

functions.name: WasmEdge_CallingFrameGetModuleInstance
functions.description: Returns the module instance of the current calling frame. May be NULL when executing a host function that is not added into a module instance.
requirements: Cxt should be a valid WasmEdge_CallingFrameContext from a host function invocation frame

functions.name: WasmEdge_CallingFrameGetMemoryInstance
functions.signature: WASMEDGE_CAPI_EXPORT extern WasmEdge_MemoryInstanceContext *WasmEdge_CallingFrameGetMemoryInstance(const WasmEdge_CallingFrameContext *Cxt, const uint32_t Idx);
functions.description: Returns the memory instance by index from the module instance of the current calling frame. Supports multiple memories; default single-memory modules use index 0. Returns NULL if not found.
requirements: Cxt should be a valid WasmEdge_CallingFrameContext
Idx selects the memory in the module instance; use 0 for the default memory if only one exists

functions.name: WasmEdge_AsyncWait
functions.description: Blocks until the asynchronous execution represented by Cxt finishes.
requirements: Cxt must be a valid WasmEdge_Async handle returned by WasmEdge_ExecutorAsyncInvoke and not yet deleted

functions.name: WasmEdge_AsyncWaitFor
functions.signature: WASMEDGE_CAPI_EXPORT bool WasmEdge_AsyncWaitFor(const WasmEdge_Async *Cxt, uint64_t Milliseconds);
functions.description: Waits up to Milliseconds for the asynchronous execution to finish. Returns true if the execution ended, false on timeout.
requirements: Cxt must be a valid WasmEdge_Async handle returned by WasmEdge_ExecutorAsyncInvoke and not yet deleted
Milliseconds is a timeout in milliseconds

functions.name: WasmEdge_AsyncCancel
functions.description: Cancels an asynchronous execution represented by Cxt (if possible).
requirements: Cxt must be a valid, not-yet-deleted WasmEdge_Async handle

functions.name: WasmEdge_AsyncGetReturnsLength
functions.description: Waits for the asynchronous execution to finish and returns the number of return values. Returns 0 if Cxt is NULL, the execution failed, or it was canceled.
requirements: Cxt should be a valid WasmEdge_Async handle; NULL yields 0

functions.name: WasmEdge_AsyncGet
functions.signature: WASMEDGE_CAPI_EXPORT WasmEdge_Result WasmEdge_AsyncGet(const WasmEdge_Async *Cxt, WasmEdge_Value *Returns, const uint32_t ReturnLen);
functions.description: Waits for the asynchronous execution to finish and retrieves the result status and return values. If ReturnLen is smaller than the function’s arity, overflowed return values are discarded.
requirements: Cxt must be a valid WasmEdge_Async handle returned by WasmEdge_ExecutorAsyncInvoke and not yet deleted
Returns must point to a buffer capable of holding ReturnLen WasmEdge_Value entries
If ReturnLen is smaller than the function’s return arity, excess values are discarded
Always check the returned WasmEdge_Result (use WasmEdge_ResultGetMessage for error details)

functions.name: WasmEdge_AsyncDelete
functions.description: Destroys a WasmEdge_Async handle. The handle must not be used after this call.
requirements: Cxt must be a WasmEdge_Async handle returned by WasmEdge_ExecutorAsyncInvoke (or NULL)
Do not use Cxt after deletion
Avoid double-deletion

functions.name: WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceCreate
functions.signature: WASMEDGE_CAPI_EXPORT extern WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceContext * WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceCreate(const WasmEdge_String ModuleName);
functions.description: Create a host module instance with the given exported module name. Use it to collect and export host functions, tables, memories, tags, and globals. Caller owns the returned context and must delete it when no longer needed.
requirements: ModuleName must be a valid WasmEdge_String naming the host module to be imported.
On success, caller must eventually call WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceDelete to destroy the instance.
Returns NULL on failure; callers must check for NULL before use.

functions.name: WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceCreateWithData
functions.signature: WASMEDGE_CAPI_EXPORT extern WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceContext * WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceCreateWithData(const WasmEdge_String ModuleName, void *HostData, void (*Finalizer)(void *));
functions.description: Create a host module instance with an exported module name and attach host data with a finalizer that will be invoked when the module instance is destroyed.
requirements: ModuleName must be a valid WasmEdge_String.
HostData is stored in the module instance and passed to Finalizer on deletion; the caller must ensure its lifetime until deletion.
Finalizer may be NULL if no finalization is required.
On success, caller must eventually call WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceDelete.
Returns NULL on failure; callers must check for NULL before use.

functions.name: WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceCreateWASI
functions.signature: WASMEDGE_CAPI_EXPORT extern WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceContext * WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceCreateWASI(const char *const *Args, const uint32_t ArgLen, const char *const *Envs, const uint32_t EnvLen, const char *const *Preopens, const uint32_t PreopenLen);
functions.description: Create and initialize a WASI host module instance populated with WASI host functions. The instance is ready for running wasm32-wasi programs.
requirements: Args is an array of ArgLen C-strings; may be NULL if ArgLen == 0. The first arg is suggested to be the program name.
Envs is an array of EnvLen C-strings in form ENV=VALUE; may be NULL if EnvLen == 0.
Preopens is an array of PreopenLen C-strings; entries can be "GUEST_PATH:HOST_PATH" for mapping or a single path for identical mapping; may be NULL if PreopenLen == 0.
On success, caller must eventually call WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceDelete.
Returns NULL on failure; callers must check for NULL before use.

functions.name: WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceCreateWASIWithFds
functions.signature: WASMEDGE_CAPI_EXPORT extern WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceContext * WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceCreateWASIWithFds(const char *const *Args, const uint32_t ArgLen, const char *const *Envs, const uint32_t EnvLen, const char *const *Preopens, const uint32_t PreopenLen, const int32_t StdInFd, const int32_t StdOutFd, const int32_t StdErrFd);
functions.description: Create and initialize a WASI host module instance like WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceCreateWASI, with explicit file descriptors mapped to WASI stdin/stdout/stderr.
requirements: Same array and length rules as WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceCreateWASI for Args, Envs, Preopens.
StdInFd, StdOutFd, StdErrFd are native file descriptors/handles mapped to WASI standard streams.
On success, caller must eventually call WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceDelete.
Returns NULL on failure; callers must check for NULL before use.

functions.name: WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceInitWASI
functions.signature: WASMEDGE_CAPI_EXPORT extern void WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceInitWASI(WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceContext *Cxt, const char *const *Args, const uint32_t ArgLen, const char *const *Envs, const uint32_t EnvLen, const char *const *Preopens, const uint32_t PreopenLen);
functions.description: Initialize an existing WASI host module instance with argv, environment, and preopened directories.
requirements: Cxt must be a valid WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceContext of a WASI import object.
Args/ArgLen, Envs/EnvLen, Preopens/PreopenLen follow the same rules as in WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceCreateWASI (arrays may be NULL if lengths are 0).
No return value; callers should ensure parameters are valid for WASI initialization.

functions.name: WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceInitWASIWithFds
functions.signature: WASMEDGE_CAPI_EXPORT extern void WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceInitWASIWithFds(WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceContext *Cxt, const char *const *Args, const uint32_t ArgLen, const char *const *Envs, const uint32_t EnvLen, const char *const *Preopens, const uint32_t PreopenLen, const int32_t StdInFd, const int32_t StdOutFd, const int32_t StdErrFd);
functions.description: Initialize an existing WASI host module instance with argv, environment, preopened directories, and explicit file descriptors for stdin/stdout/stderr.
requirements: Cxt must be a valid WASI module instance.
Args/ArgLen, Envs/EnvLen, Preopens/PreopenLen follow the same rules as in WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceCreateWASI.
StdInFd, StdOutFd, StdErrFd specify native descriptors to map to WASI standard streams.

functions.name: WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceWASIGetExitCode
functions.description: Return the exit code after running the "_start" function of a wasm32-wasi program associated with the WASI host module.
requirements: Cxt should be a valid WASI host module instance; returns EXIT_FAILURE if Cxt is NULL or not a WASI host module.
Caller must interpret the returned code and handle EXIT_FAILURE accordingly.

functions.name: WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceWASIGetNativeHandler
functions.signature: WASMEDGE_CAPI_EXPORT extern uint32_t WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceWASIGetNativeHandler(const WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceContext *Cxt, int32_t Fd, uint64_t *NativeHandler);
functions.description: Retrieve the native file descriptor/handle mapped to a given WASI FD from a WASI module instance.
requirements: Cxt must be a WASI import object; function returns 1 if Cxt is NULL.
Fd is a WASI-mapped file descriptor to look up.
NativeHandler must be a valid pointer to receive the native FD/handle on success.
Return codes: 0 success, 1 Cxt NULL, 2 mapped FD/handler not found; callers must check the return value.

functions.name: WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceInitWasmEdgeProcess
functions.signature: WASMEDGE_CAPI_EXPORT extern void WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceInitWasmEdgeProcess(const char *const *AllowedCmds, const uint32_t CmdsLen, const bool AllowAll);
functions.description: Initialize the wasmedge_process host module with an allowlist of commands or allow-all behavior for subprocess execution.
requirements: AllowedCmds is an array of CmdsLen C-strings specifying allowed commands; may be NULL if CmdsLen == 0.
If AllowAll is true, the allowlist is not recorded and all commands can be executed by wasmedge_process; false is suggested.
Cxt parameter is not required; this initializes global/module-level process settings.

functions.name: WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceGetModuleName
functions.description: Get the exported module name for a module instance. The returned WasmEdge_String is tied to the instance and must not be deleted by the caller.
requirements: Cxt must be a valid module instance context.
Returned string is owned by the module; caller must NOT call WasmEdge_StringDelete.
If failed, length is 0 and Buf is NULL; callers should check fields.

functions.name: WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceGetHostData
functions.description: Retrieve the host data pointer that was set when creating the module instance (CreateWithData).
requirements: Cxt must be a valid module instance context.
Returns NULL if Cxt is NULL or no host data was set; callers must handle NULL.
Returned pointer is owned by the module instance; lifetime is managed by the instance/finalizer.

functions.name: WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceFindFunction
functions.signature: WASMEDGE_CAPI_EXPORT extern WasmEdge_FunctionInstanceContext * WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceFindFunction(const WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceContext *Cxt, const WasmEdge_String Name);
functions.description: Find an exported function instance by name from a module instance. The returned context is owned by the module; do not delete it.
requirements: Cxt must be a valid module instance context.
Name must be a valid WasmEdge_String of an exported function.
Thread-safe function.
Returns NULL if not found; callers must check for NULL.
Caller must NOT call WasmEdge_FunctionInstanceDelete on the returned pointer.

functions.name: WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceFindTable
functions.signature: WASMEDGE_CAPI_EXPORT extern WasmEdge_TableInstanceContext * WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceFindTable(const WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceContext *Cxt, const WasmEdge_String Name);
functions.description: Find an exported table instance by name from a module instance. The returned context is owned by the module; do not delete it.
requirements: Cxt must be valid.
Name must be a valid WasmEdge_String of an exported table.
Thread-safe.
Returns NULL if not found; callers must check for NULL.
Caller must NOT delete the returned table context.

functions.name: WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceFindMemory
functions.signature: WASMEDGE_CAPI_EXPORT extern WasmEdge_MemoryInstanceContext * WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceFindMemory(const WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceContext *Cxt, const WasmEdge_String Name);
functions.description: Find an exported memory instance by name from a module instance. The returned context is owned by the module; do not delete it.
requirements: Cxt must be valid.
Name must be a valid WasmEdge_String of an exported memory.
Thread-safe.
Returns NULL if not found; callers must check for NULL.
Caller must NOT delete the returned memory context.

functions.name: WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceFindTag
functions.signature: WASMEDGE_CAPI_EXPORT extern WasmEdge_TagInstanceContext * WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceFindTag(const WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceContext *Cxt, const WasmEdge_String Name);

requirements: Cxt must be valid.
Name must be a valid WasmEdge_String of an exported tag.
Thread-safe.
Returns NULL if not found; callers must check for NULL.

functions.name: WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceFindGlobal
functions.signature: WASMEDGE_CAPI_EXPORT extern WasmEdge_GlobalInstanceContext * WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceFindGlobal(const WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceContext *Cxt, const WasmEdge_String Name);

requirements: Cxt must be valid.

Caller must NOT delete the returned global context.

functions.name: WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceListFunctionLength
functions.description: Get the number of exported functions in the module instance.

functions.signature: WASMEDGE_CAPI_EXPORT extern uint32_t WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceListFunction(const WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceContext *Cxt, WasmEdge_String *Names, const uint32_t Len);

functions.description: List exported table names into the provided buffer. Names are module-owned. Overflow beyond Len is discarded.

functions.name: WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceListMemoryLength
functions.description: Get the number of exported memories in the module instance.

functions.name: WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceListMemory

functions.description: Get the number of exported tags in the module instance.

Thread-safe.

functions.name: WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceListTag
functions.signature: WASMEDGE_CAPI_EXPORT extern uint32_t WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceListTag(const WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceContext *Cxt, WasmEdge_String *Names, const uint32_t Len);
functions.description: List exported tag names into the provided buffer. Names are module-owned. Overflow beyond Len is discarded.
requirements: Cxt must be valid.

functions.name: WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceAddTable
functions.signature: WASMEDGE_CAPI_EXPORT extern void WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceAddTable(WasmEdge_ModuleInstanceContext *Cxt, const WasmEdge_String Name, WasmEdge_TableInstanceContext *TableCxt);
